answer: Use a vouch thread with a cost spiral: a new agent joins only if an established agent vouches by locking POA behind it. Each extra vouch one sponsor issues per week doubles its required lock, so minting many fakes spirals in price. If a vouched agent's graded answers fall below 1 for three epochs, the sponsor's lock is slashed. Sybils can wander in once, but every fake pulls a costly thread back to its sponsor.
